This pump is used to suction air and steam from condenser to make vacuum 
 inside condenser.

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I3, which must be carried 
 out every month as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Shady Ghazy and tested by maintenance 
 manager eng. Ahmad shanabe, and revised by maintenance general manager eng. Omran 
 Abd El Hamid Shoaib approved by Eng.Ahmed Sawan 
 Nubria power station head sector and revised 
 by MDEPC inspection & quality control eng. 
 Abouda El Bana , and certified by eng. Samir Abd Algalil inspection & 
 quality control general director, MPIS coordinator approved by eng. 
 Mohamed Nagieb inspection & quality control 
 head sector

items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required

Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor

Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Complete maintenance tool set.

Straight edge, rugs, cleaning 
 fluid. Dial indicator
Measure vibration level for bearings and compare it

Check 
 discharge quantity and pressure and record it.
Check Any Leakage From Pump & Piping flanges
Measuring bearing temperature

Check 
 any leakage from glands
Replace grease of bearing house

Check bolts fixation, then 
 re-tightens it (if it is needed).
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value
Replace rubber pads in coupling
Replace gland packing

Clean external part with compressed 
 air

Check the pump casing against rust 
 and re-paint (if it is needed)

Check the direction of rotation of pump before starting the pump for the first 
 time.
Open suction valve of pump
Open delivery valve gradually after pump operate to its full speed.
Check the temperature of the bearing
Check the vibration of the pump
Check discharge quantity and pressure

Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This pump is used to suction air and steam from condenser to make vacuum 
 inside condenser.
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I3, which must be carried 
 out every month as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Shady Ghazy and tested by maintenance 
 manager eng. Ahmad shanabe, and revised by maintenance general manager eng. Omran 
 Abd El Hamid Shoaib approved by Eng.Ahmed Sawan 
 Nubria power station head sector and revised 
 by MDEPC inspection & quality control eng. 
 Abouda El Bana , and certified by eng. Samir Abd Algalil inspection & 
 quality control general director, MPIS coordinator approved by eng. 
 Mohamed Nagieb inspection & quality control 
 head sector
Technical Specifications
Quantity | 4
Manufactur | AWAMURA
Type | SONIT-F200B
Water Flow | 1740 m 3/h
Pressure | 33.9 mbar
Motor (KW) | 90
Speed (RPM) | 585
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor
The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Straight edge, rugs, cleaning 
 fluid. Dial indicator
Work to be 
carried out
Pump in 
 operation
Measure vibration level for bearings and compare it
Check 
 discharge quantity and pressure and record it.
Check Any Leakage From Pump & Piping flanges
Measuring bearing temperature
Check 
 any leakage from glands
Pump out of operation
Replace grease of bearing house
Check bolts fixation, then 
 re-tightens it (if it is needed).
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value
Replace rubber pads in coupling
Replace gland packing
Clean external part with compressed 
 air
Check the pump casing against rust 
 and re-paint (if it is needed)
Starting the Pump
Check the direction of rotation of pump before starting the pump for the first 
 time.
Open suction valve of pump
Open delivery valve gradually after pump operate to its full speed.
Attendance and checking during 
operation
Check the temperature of the bearing
Check the vibration of the pump
Check discharge quantity and pressure
